description: This file defines classes and functions related to managing iSCSI configuration data and commands within a kickstart installation process, including different versions for RHEL and Fedora systems.

classes.name: FC6_IscsiData
classes.description: Data class for iSCSI configuration specific to FC6 version.

classes.name: F10_IscsiData
classes.description: Data class for iSCSI configuration for F10, extending FC6_IscsiData with reverse CHAP options.

classes.name: RHEL6_IscsiData
classes.description: Data class for RHEL6, extending F10_IscsiData with interface option.

classes.name: F17_IscsiData
classes.description: Version of RHEL6_IscsiData for F17, inherits behavior.

classes.name: FC6_Iscsi
classes.description: Kickstart command class for managing multiple iSCSI configurations during installation.

methods.name: _getArgsAsStr
methods.description: Constructs command-line argument string for iSCSI configuration based on class attributes.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates argument parser for the iSCSI kickstart command, with version-specific options.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into data objects.

methods.name: dataList
methods.description: Returns the list of iSCSI data objects.

methods.name: dataClass
methods.description: Property that returns the data class associated with the command.
